decisions_made.decision: Use debouncing for medicine history search to optimize client performance
decisions_made.reason: Avoids rendering and filtering lag during user typing inputs.

decisions_made.decision: Use stopPropagation on phone links in patient rows to prevent accidental navigation
decisions_made.reason: Improves mobile and desktop UX by isolating telephone action from row navigation.

decisions_made.decision: Remove printing and duplicate merge actions from client dashboards
decisions_made.reason: Streamlines layout options and reduces UI clutter.
